summary.intent: Assess and execute CipherBox Phase 72 (SDK write-plane durability/correctness): audit pending todos for drift from phases 70/70.1/71, then run plan→execute→ship for Phase 72 before repeating for Phase 73.
summary.outcome: Two CI regressions from phases 70.1/71 were root-caused, fixed, and merged (PR #601 FUSE seq-equivocation + D-16 driver fix + perf opt; PR #600 web floor-store helper + sdk-e2e Test 21 idempotency fix + 4 web-e2e flake fixes), then all 10 Phase 72 plans executed across 7 waves with green builds/tests; a newly-discovered vitest v2→v3 + retired-type test drift (113 TS errors) is being fixed and wired into CI as a final hardening plan before phase verification and ship.

repo: GSD todos are closed by deletion from pending/ and copied into completed/ (not a separate resolved/ folder, which is a red herring and stays empty)

ci-e2e.yml (Web/Desktop E2E) triggers ONLY on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch, never on pull_request; dispatch with `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>`, not `-f ref=` (the latter 422s if the workflow definition on main predates that input)

Playwright web-e2e's `ciFloor()` helper only raises wait timeouts to 60s under CI — locally the same waits use their bare (15-30s) values, causing tests to flake locally on a loaded machine while passing reliably in CI; representative local verification requires running with CI=1 semantics

playwright.config.ts webServer uses `reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI`, so setting CI=1 locally to get the ciFloor timeout regime conflicts with an already-running dev stack unless that line is temporarily patched

Root `pnpm typecheck` only runs each package's build script (tsconfig.build.json, which excludes tests) plus tsconfig.scripts.json — test files are never typechecked in CI even though each package's base tsconfig.json includes them

@cipherbox/* packages resolve cross-package types via workspace symlinks to built `dist` (no path aliases or TS project references), so test-inclusive typechecking of a package requires its upstream deps already built
Fresh git worktrees in this pnpm monorepo lack node_modules — a known failure mode that makes worktree-isolated parallel execution unreliable here
IPNS anti-equivocation gate (Phase 71) rejects same-sequence republish with a different CID; FUSE's per-file first-publish path must resolve-before-publish rather than blindly using seq=1

Phase 71 (#599) shipped with undetected test/fixture drift in three places: stale DTO field names in a desktop-e2e .mts driver, an sdk-e2e assertion that didn't account for its own idempotency, and it exposed a latent FUSE seq-1 bug

Phase 70.1 collapsed two IndexedDB stores (generation-high-water, seq-high-water) into one `rotation-floor` store (DB v2, keyed by nodeId) — old store names are gone, so any code/tests still probing them silently no-op
Commit hangs after `git commit` are often the 1Password SSH signing prompt, not an actual failure — always verify via git log whether the commit landed before retrying

code.finding: publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on the first-publish branch gated only by 'inode cid empty', so a dropped/stale UploadComplete re-triggering it re-sealed at seq=1 with a new CID, tripping the anti-equivocation gate. Fixed by resolving IPNS first: NotFound → true first-publish, Found(seq) → route into publish_with_cas_retry with the resolved seq.

publish_with_cas_retry gained an optional preresolved_seq param so callers that already resolved the sequence (the Found path in content_ops.rs) skip a redundant second resolve; conflict-retry path always re-resolves since a pre-resolved value is stale after a conflict.
ciFloor() helper raises wait timeouts under CI only (e.g. to 60s) — any test using a bare local timeout below that floor is systematically tighter locally than in CI, producing local-only flakes.

workflow: When a subagent's diagnosis says a failure is 'pre-existing/unrelated', still verify by checking whether the same failure occurs on main/base before trusting it and moving on

For unattended long-running phase execution, prefer sequential execution on the main tree over worktree isolation when the phase is heavily serialized on one file (e.g. client.ts) and the monorepo has known worktree/node_modules issues
User explicitly directed 'source fixes only, keep retries:0' — reactive fix-at-source over CI retry policies is the team's stated flakiness philosophy

User corrected sequencing preference for a new CI gate from 'typecheck before build' to 'build first, then typecheck' once informed that cross-package types resolve via built dist (accepting the technical constraint rather than insisting on the original order)

Capture discovered but out-of-scope issues (e.g. widespread TS test-file drift) as a durable pending todo immediately, so the finding survives context compaction and gets sequenced as a deliberate later plan rather than lost or rushed

friction: Repeated local web-e2e verification runs cascaded on a different flaky test each time (2.1 create-folder, 4.10 batch delete, 4.11 batch move) due to local timeouts being tighter than CI's ciFloor-raised ones, requiring several throwaway runs and a config patch (CI=1 + reuseExistingServer override) before a clean local pass was achieved
`gh workflow run -f ref=` failed with HTTP 422 because main's workflow definition predated the `ref` input; had to discover `--ref <branch>` as the working form
Initially checked the wrong todo directory (resolved/, which is empty) before being corrected to completed/
gsd-core hook JSON contains raw multiline strings that break strict JSON parsing; had to write a custom lenient parser script to extract research/tdd/schema-gate fragments

Executor subagent sandboxes couldn't read .env, so several live sdk-e2e tests (bin-operations, resurrection guard confirmation) were implemented and typechecked but not runtime-verified during execution, deferring that to phase verification
sdk-e2e Test 21 (D-06) was flaky/non-deterministic by design (same-CID idempotency allows two valid outcomes) and initially caused confusion about whether #600 or #601 introduced a regression
open_items: Fix all 113 pre-existing test-file TypeScript errors across 15 files (api-client, sdk-core cas/grant tests, and ~12 sdk test files with retired-type/Mock-generics drift) — in progress, sdk-core+api-client agent finished clean, sdk package agent still running at transcript end

Wire a test-inclusive typecheck (tc per package) into the root `pnpm typecheck`/CI Typecheck job, sequenced after builds per user's latest direction — not yet applied (waiting on sdk test-file agent to finish to avoid races)
Run deferred live sdk-e2e tests (bin-operations, resurrection-guard) and a web-e2e run for the SC#6 high-blast-radius dedup (72-08) before/at phase verification, per the executor's own flag
tee-republish.test.ts fails on an uninitialized tee_key_state table — pre-existing environment gap, explicitly kept out of Phase 72 gate scope
Run gsd-verifier for goal-backward Phase 72 verification, then /ship-phase 72 (PR, CI, merge) including the held bookkeeping commits
Repeat the plan→execute→ship flow for Phase 73 once Phase 72 is merged (73 depends on 72 via shared client.ts write-plane changes)

68.2-coderabbit-hardening-backlog items beyond the web-scoped ones (item 4 stale write envelope, item 9 nav seed race) remain a bundled multi-area backlog to cherry-pick later, not folded wholesale into Phase 73

Cosmetic plan-checker warnings for Phase 72 (wave metadata over-serialization, missing RESOLVED markers in RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md seed rows not backfilled) were deliberately left unaddressed as non-blocking
